# Mr. Frozen — Shree Laxmi Frozen Foods

> Mr. Frozen is the frozen-food brand of Shree Laxmi Frozen Foods, based in Farrukhabad, India. The company has annual production capacity exceeding 8,000 metric tonnes and supplies frozen food products for domestic and international markets. The business supports bulk supply, white-label and private-label requirements, as well as import and export requirements.

## Products

- [Frozen Green Peas](https://www.shreelaxmifrozenfoods.com/products/frozen-peas): Frozen green peas.
- [American Sweet Corn](https://www.shreelaxmifrozenfoods.com/products/american-sweet-corn): Frozen American sweet corn.
- [Carrots](https://www.shreelaxmifrozenfoods.com/products/carrots): Frozen carrots.
- [Cauliflower](https://www.shreelaxmifrozenfoods.com/products/cauliflower): Frozen cauliflower.
- [Frozen Soya Chaap](https://www.shreelaxmifrozenfoods.com/products/frozen-soya-chaap): Protein-rich frozen soya chaap.

## Capabilities

- Annual production capacity exceeding 8,000 metric tonnes.
- Bulk frozen-food supply.
- White-label and private-label supply.
- Import and export requirements.
- Supply for distributors, restaurants, food-service businesses and commercial buyers.
